ctx.x: But did you go over to NBC and apply, or did they come -- did someone you knew tell you there was a job or what?

No, I went and I talked to the contractor of the job. His name was Frank Vanione. And Spitalny was over him. But Vanione screened everyone and did the hiring, you know. And I told him that I had worked with Benny Goodman. They had confused -- they was confused with me working with some other bandleader with the name Goodman, you know. I said, no, Benny Goodman, the King of Swing, you know. Well, however, I played this comedy show in the morning. Then we had an Army and Navy game, whereas they'd have a fellow from…
How about Eddie Barefield? Did he start at the same time you did?
